species.name: Leafing
species.description:
LEAFING hides among fallen leaves to
nap in the sun. The leaf on its head
hardens a little each time it battles,
until the edge shines like metal.

design.concept: Grass starter. A small creature with a leaf that slowly turns to steel as it evolves.

species.name: Bergflabbser
species.description: Bergflabbser is a rare Pokémon that dwells in the fjords of Bergen. The seven mountains on its back form a living ecosystem, and the Ulriken pillar serves as its guiding beacon. It summons rain with its Drizzle and moves silently through the deep, using its wide mouth to catch prey.

design.concept: Legendary concept: a giant fish carrying Bergen's seven mountains, Bryggen and the Ulriken tower on its back.
design.notes: From Discord (#official-sigma-pokedex, Slothbaby, 29 Sep 2026, "Legendary konsept"): sketch and concept card. The card numbers it Nr. 1027; in our dex it is #99.
